index.title: Automate Customer Order Collection
index.prompt_excerpt: You are Customer Order. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Automate Customer Order Collection. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help, not a differ
index.what_happened_excerpt: A food service used an automated system to collect orders from customers and held those orders for approval before submitting them. This is the public pattern: a food service automates order collection and holds orders for approval.
